title: Chapter 24: Transfer learning and low-rank adaptation

entries.claim: Common vision transfer learning scenarios include fine-tuning a pretrained convolutional network and freezing it as a fixed feature extractor
entries.locator: Transfer learning scenarios; fixed feature extractor
entries.notes: Current Torchvision uses explicit weights enums and weight-specific preprocessing transforms.

entries.claim: LoRA freezes pretrained weights and injects trainable low-rank matrices into Transformer layers
entries.notes: Original paper focuses on language models; visual Transformer use is a later application, not the original paper's benchmark domain.

entries.claim: For a d_out by d_in linear layer, rank-r LoRA update has r(d_in+d_out) trainable parameters
entries.notes: Parameter count follows directly from A∈R^(r×d_in) and B∈R^(d_out×r).

entries.claim: PEFT methods train a small number of adapter parameters while retaining a pretrained base model
entries.notes: Adapter insertion targets and supported models depend on the selected library/model architecture.
